summary: Ascentage Pharma furnished a Form 6-K covering two Hong Kong voluntary announcements: a trustee purchase of 50,000 existing shares on-market on September 28, 2026 for its 2022 RSU scheme, representing roughly 0.01% of issued shares at total consideration of HK$1,428,000, or about HK$28.56 per share; and a separate acquisition of shares by the Chairman and Executive Director. Both transactions are routine share purchases under an equity incentive trust and insider buying, not a special-situation event; no board recommendation, advisor, or structural changes are stated. Watch for continued trustee and insider accumulation signals.
